properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's block-by-block reconciliation pass, cross-checking OCII's own numbered Land Use Map (Dec 2019, data/manual/_reference/mission_bay_land_use_map_2019.png) against everything already tracked: 1180 Fourth Street, a 150-unit affordable housing development (50 units for formerly homeless residents) on a full city block, designed by Kennerly Architecture & Planning with Mithun|Solomon and Full Circle Architecture, opened 2015; 216,000 sq ft with ground-floor retail along 4th St and a mid-block courtyard. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) 'On a full city block' is not stated by any cited source; Mithun's project page gives 217,620 sf on 1.4 acres at the corner of Fourth and Channel Streets. (2) Mithun (formerly WRT/Solomon E.T.C., 'Mithun|Solomon') is the architect; Kennerly Architecture and Planning is the associate design architect and Full Circle Architects (not 'Architecture') the associate architect. (3) 'Opened 2015': Mithun gives completion 2014; DBI permit 201012036075 shows completed 2015-04-02 and the Assessor year built is 2015; the Mercy Housing opening celebration was in May 2015. (4) '216,000 sq ft' appears in no source read; Mithun gives 217,620 sf. 2026-10-10 link fix: the ULI case-study page (http://web.archive.org/web/20250526145718/https://casestudies.uli.org/1180-fourth-street/) now shows a landing page, so source_doc_urls points to its 2025-05-26 Internet Archive copy instead. The geometry is unchanged. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8711501 (6,026 m2, active, mapped 2015-12-09); the earlier outline of 4,614 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.70 (95% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 72% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 4 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8711501 and 3 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8711014), address confirmed via DataSF Assessor parcel data (blklot 8711501) and architect/press project pages (no OSM name/address tag found on this footprint); not a hand trace or plan estimate. No OSM building/name tag found on this footprint; address and history confirmed via architect project pages and press coverage instead.'. Previous notes: 'No OSM building/name tag found on this footprint; address and history confirmed via architect project pages and press coverage instead.'. 2026-10-12 audit text fix (no change to shape, status, use or geometry_type): (1) Units: Mithun's project page ('150 residential units'; '150 low-income families, 50 of them formerly homeless') and DBI permit 201012036075 ('erect 6 stories of 150 dwelling unit') give 150; the 2025 Assessor roll for lot 8711501 lists 160 units, a difference no source read explains. (2) Size: Mithun gives '217,620 sf; 1.4 acres'; the Assessor roll's property area is 215,000, a different measure that is not reconciled. (3) Opening: no source read gives an opening date, so 'opened 2015' above is withdrawn. Mercy Housing California's release of December 11, 2014 (posted on Mithun's site) says it 'announced today the completion of 1180 Fourth Street'; Mithun gives 'Completion Date 2014'; the DBI permit shows completed 2015-04-02 and the Assessor year built is 2015. The May 2015 opening celebration came from a Mercy Housing page that could not be read (HTTP 404 on 2026-10-12), so it is unconfirmed. (4) Retail: Mithun's project page gives '10,000 sf ground-level retail space' and 'a multilevel courtyard at the mid-block'; the December 11, 2014 release says '11,000 square feet of retail space lining Fourth Street', which supports 'along 4th St' but gives a different area.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8711501 (6,026 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 4 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8711501 and 3 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8711014)); 95% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 72% of the lot.
properties.notes: No OSM building/name tag found on the building's footprint; address and history confirmed via architect project pages and press coverage instead. Sources differ on some figures: 150 units (Mithun, building permit) against 160 (2025 Assessor roll); 217,620 sf (Mithun) against a 215,000 Assessor property area; 10,000 sf (Mithun) against 11,000 sf (December 2014 Mercy Housing California release, on Mithun's site) of ground-level retail. Mithun gives a 2014 completion and the building permit closed on 2015-04-02; no source read gives an opening date.
